turns.query: How much should I trust the actual number though? It moves around a lot.

relevant.evidence:
Eh measurement may show qualitative trends but generally
cannot be interpreted as equilibrium values.

ORP reference offset: ORP values depend on the electrode’s reference type (Ag/AgCl vs.
standard hydrogen electrode). Record which reference is used so values are comparable across
DataPods and over time. Treat ORP trend as more reliable than absolute value.

A single redox potential cannot be assigned to a
disequilibrium system, nor can it be assigned to a water sample
without specifying the particular redox species to which it refers.

Seawater’s high ionic strength makes absolute
readings less comparable between sites — trend matters more than the raw number.
